results.name: ZMod.val_add
results.source_text:
theorem val_add {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a b : ZMod n) : (a + b).val = (a.val + b.val) % n := by
  cases n
  · cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  · apply Fin.val_add

results.name: ZMod.val
results.source_text:
/-- `val a` is a natural number defined as:
  - for `a : ZMod 0` it is the absolute value of `a`
  - for `a : ZMod n` with `0 < n` it is the least natural number in the equivalence class

See `ZMod.valMinAbs` for a variant that takes values in the integers.
-/
def val : ∀ {n : ℕ}, ZMod n → ℕ
  | 0 => Int.natAbs
  | n + 1 => ((↑) : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)
results.docstring:
`val a` is a natural number defined as:
- for `a : ZMod 0` it is the absolute value of `a`
- for `a : ZMod n` with `0 < n` it is the least natural number in the equivalence class

See `ZMod.valMinAbs` for a variant that takes values in the integers.

results.name: ZMod.val_add_le
results.source_text:
theorem val_add_le {n : ℕ} (a b : ZMod n) : (a + b).val ≤ a.val + b.val := by
  cases n
  · simpa [ZMod.val] using! Int.natAbs_add_le _ _
  · simpa [ZMod.val_add] using! Nat.mod_le _ _

results.name: Nat.add_div_of_dvd_right
results.source_text:
protected theorem add_div_of_dvd_right {a b c : ℕ} (hca : c ∣ a) : (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c :=
  if h : c = 0 then by simp [h]
  else
    add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt
      (by
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hca, zero_add]
        exact Nat.mod_lt _ (zero_lt_of_ne_zero h))

results.name: DivisibleBy
results.source_text:
/--
An `AddMonoid A` is `α`-divisible iff `n • x = a` has a solution for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
Here we adopt a constructive approach where we ask an explicit `div : A → α → A` function such that
* `div a 0 = 0` for all `a ∈ A`
* `n • div a n = a` for all `n ≠ 0 ∈ α` and `a ∈ A`.
-/
class DivisibleBy where
  /-- The division function -/
  div : A → α → A
  div_zero : ∀ a, div a 0 = 0
  div_cancel : ∀ {n : α} (a : A), n ≠ 0 → n • div a n = a

results.name: Nat.add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt
results.source_text:
theorem add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt {a b c : ℕ} (hc : a % c + b % c < c) :
    (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c :=
  if hc0 : c = 0 then by simp [hc0]
  else by rw [Nat.add_div (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0), if_neg (not_le_of_gt hc), add_zero]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
